source.title: Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1955, p. 5 ("Not a Single Contest: County and Rural Councillors Unopposed") ("Co. Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page (clean apart from the noted spellings; not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1955: nominations received by H. W. F. Reid, returning officer; not more than one candidate for each seat, so there was no poll. No party labels printed, so none are given. Returned unopposed. George Leyburn: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Unionist (South-East Ward, Armagh Urban District, 21 May 1952, printed 'Unionists': Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1952, p. 6 ("Armagh"); also the Armagh Guardian, 9 May 1952, p. 1; South Ward, Armagh Urban District, 18 May 1955, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 6 May 1955, p. 1 ("Armagh Council elections: no opposition for Unionists"; "To be returned unopposed")).
